question_record.context: A security incident was flagged when a known credential theft tool execution `mimikatz.exe` with ProcessId `6600` and command line intended to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords was detected. The IP address associated was `107.224.99.179`. This incident is indicative of malicious activity, potentially compromising user accounts for lateral movement within the network.
question_record.question: What is the name of the ransomware-related file that was delivered by the compromised user account?
solution: A known credential theft tool was detected on the host with AadDeviceId `4d8d23e9-a77d-4e33-9435-b8c457e57ca1`.
PSExec was used for lateral movement to the jump server at IP address `99.83.111.100`.
A possible compromised user account delivered ransomware-related file `characterical.zip.lockbit` on several devices.

131.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
131.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

174.name: PSExec to Vnevado-jump
174.description: Lateral movement to the jump server

93.name: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
93.description: A user account was observed dropping a ransomware-related file on several devices. An attacker may have compromised the said user account to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices with ransomware as possible. Automated remediation action may be taken to disable the account.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s,%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
